title: handroanthus billbergii subsp. ampla

The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Handroanthus billbergii subsp. ampla include diterpenes, particularly the diterpenoid amide and other sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
